comments.quote: We booked three rooms for the National Day holiday. The trip from Shanghai was less than three hours, and we checked into the guesthouse for our family outing. Houwu Village is very quiet, just 10 minutes from Jiangnan Yaowu Scenic...

comments.quote: 房間乾淨整潔，枕頭是乳膠的，門口好停車，環境安靜。自帶陽台打開就是風景。老闆和老闆娘很熱情，走路2分鐘有家芸豆農家菜，味道很好。
